description: Measures blood glucose at scheduled times after a glucose drink to see how the body processes sugar. It is used to evaluate glucose intolerance and may be used in pregnancy screening.
preparationInstruction: Follow the laboratory's fasting instructions, commonly an overnight fast; remain at the laboratory for timed blood samples and follow activity/food instructions.
overview: Blood glucose at specified time points after glucose drink

name: Lh, Fsh , Prolactin

description: Measures or detects lh, fsh , prolactin in the specified sample to support assessment of the related body function or condition. Results should be interpreted by a qualified clinician in the context of symptoms and other findings.

description: Measures vitamin b12, 25-hydroxyvitamin d in the blood to help assess nutritional status. A clinician interprets the result alongside symptoms, history and other relevant findings.
preparationInstruction: Usually no fasting required unless combined with other tests; follow laboratory instructions.

description: Measures substances such as creatinine and urea, and sometimes electrolytes, to assess kidney function. It helps clinicians evaluate how well the kidneys filter waste and maintain fluid/electrolyte balance.

preparationInstruction: Pregnancy dating/ultrasound information may be required. No fasting is usually needed; follow the ordering clinician's instructions.

name: Stool Routine Examination
shortDescription: Examines a stool sample for the findings specified by the test, such as cells, parasites or hidden blood.
description: Examines a stool sample for the findings specified by the test, such as cells, parasites or hidden blood. It can help clinicians investigate digestive symptoms or support screening when appropriate.
preparationInstruction: Collect a fresh stool sample in the supplied clean container; avoid urine/water contamination and deliver promptly.
overview: microscopy for cells/parasites and other reported findings

name: Stool Occult Blood
shortDescription: Examines a stool sample for the findings specified by the test, such as cells, parasites or hidden blood.
description: Examines a stool sample for the findings specified by the test, such as cells, parasites or hidden blood. It can help clinicians investigate digestive symptoms or support screening when appropriate.
preparationInstruction: Collect stool as instructed. Some methods require dietary/medicine restrictions; follow the kit/laboratory instructions.

name: Semen Analysis
shortDescription: Evaluates semen characteristics including sperm concentration, movement and appearance.
description: Evaluates semen characteristics including sperm concentration, movement and appearance. It is commonly used as part of an assessment of male fertility.
preparationInstruction: Follow the laboratory's abstinence period, commonly 2–7 days; collect the complete sample in the approved container and deliver within the instructed time.
